items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I went there, because my brother knew a doctor there named Dr. Dorsey, and I lived with Dr. Dorsey, he owned a drugstore.

ctx.x: But when you stayed in Chicago, it was to go to this music college, was it?

Yeah, I went there, because my brother knew a doctor there named Dr. Dorsey, and I lived with Dr. Dorsey, he owned a drugstore. And then from -- I worked a little at the lunch counter and I would go down to this trade school. You'd work your way through it, and I worked in the bakery shop for awhile.
Well, what did you learn in this school?
